import MumfordLib.SimplicialCohomologyConnecting
import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyPullback
import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyMayerVietorisConsumer

/-!
# Singular classes in the simplicial connecting calculation

The canonical simplicial class map agrees with the existing integral singular
class map. Pullback of representatives along a simplicial map agrees with the
homology functor, including the subcomplex comparisons used in Mayer--Vietoris.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory HomologicalComplex

namespace Mumford.Analytic

/-- Simplicial cocycles on the singular simplicial set are singular cocycles. -/
theorem simplicialCocycles_toSSet (X : TopCat) (n : ℕ) :
    simplicialCocycles (TopCat.toSSet.obj X) n = singularCocycles X n := rfl

/-- The simplicial class of a singular cocycle is its established singular class. -/
@[simp]
theorem simplicialCohomologyClass_toSSet (X : TopCat) (n : ℕ) :
    simplicialCohomologyClass (TopCat.toSSet.obj X) n =
      singularCohomologyClass X n := by
  exact (congrArg (fun f => f.hom) (singularCohomologyClass_eq_cycles X n)).symm

/-- Pullback of a simplicial cocycle represents the induced homology class. -/
theorem simplicialCohomologyClass_pullback {K L : SSet} (f : K ⟶ L) (n : ℕ)
    (φ : simplicialCocycles L n) :
    homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback f) n
      (simplicialCohomologyClass L n φ) =
        simplicialCohomologyClass K n
          ⟨simplicialCochainPullback f n φ.1, by
            change simplicialCochainDifferential K n
              (simplicialCochainPullback f n φ.1) = 0
            rw [← simplicialCochainPullback_differential, φ.2, map_zero]⟩ := by
  let F : simplicialCocycles L n →ₗ[ℤ] simplicialCocycles K n :=
    ((simplicialCochainPullback f n).comp (simplicialCocycles L n).subtype).codRestrict _
      (by
        intro ψ
        change simplicialCochainDifferential K n
          (simplicialCochainPullback f n ψ.1) = 0
        rw [← simplicialCochainPullback_differential, ψ.2, map_zero])
  have hcycles : simplicialCocycleToCycles L n ≫
      cyclesMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback f) n =
        ModuleCat.ofHom F ≫ simplicialCocycleToCycles K n := by
    apply (cancel_mono ((integralSimplicialCochainComplex K).iCycles n)).mp
    simp only [Category.assoc, cyclesMap_i]
    rw [← Category.assoc]
    simp only [simplicialCocycleToCycles, liftCycles_i,
      integralSimplicialCochainPullback_f]
    rfl
  have hclass : ModuleCat.ofHom (simplicialCohomologyClass L n) ≫
      homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback f) n =
        ModuleCat.ofHom F ≫ ModuleCat.ofHom (simplicialCohomologyClass K n) := by
    change (simplicialCocycleToCycles L n ≫ _) ≫ _ =
      ModuleCat.ofHom F ≫ (simplicialCocycleToCycles K n ≫ _)
    rw [Category.assoc, homologyπ_naturality, ← Category.assoc, hcycles, Category.assoc]
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hclass φ

/-- A cochain lift on the two singular subcomplexes and a global cocycle whose
restrictions are its differentials compute the ordinary singular connecting class. -/
theorem singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting_class_of_lift
    (X : TopCat) (U V : Set X) (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hcover : U ∪ V = Set.univ) (n : ℕ)
    (γ : singularCocycles (TopCat.of (U ∩ V : Set X)) n)
    (α : IntegralSimplicialCochain (singularSubset X U) n)
    (β : IntegralSimplicialCochain (singularSubset X V) n)
    (θ : singularCocycles X (n + 1))
    (hγ : simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference
        (singularSubset X U) (singularSubset X V) n (α, β) =
      simplicialCochainPullback
        ((SSet.Subcomplex.eqToIso (singularSubset_inter X U V)).inv ≫
          (singularSubsetIso X (U ∩ V : Set X)).inv) n γ.1)
    (hθ : simplicialCochainUnionRestriction
        (singularSubset X U) (singularSubset X V) (n + 1)
        (simplicialCochainPullback
          (singularSubset X U ⊔ singularSubset X V).ι (n + 1) θ.1) =
      (simplicialCochainDifferential (singularSubset X U) n α,
        simplicialCochainDifferential (singularSubset X V) n β)) :
    singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting X U V hU hV hcover n
      (singularCohomologyClass _ n γ) =
        singularCohomologyClass X (n + 1) θ := by
  let A := singularSubset X U
  let B := singularSubset X V
  let f : (A ⊓ B : (TopCat.toSSet.obj X).Subcomplex).toSSet ⟶
      TopCat.toSSet.obj (TopCat.of (U ∩ V : Set X)) :=
    (SSet.Subcomplex.eqToIso (singularSubset_inter X U V)).inv ≫
      (singularSubsetIso X (U ∩ V : Set X)).inv
  let γ' : simplicialCocycles (A ⊓ B : (TopCat.toSSet.obj X).Subcomplex) n :=
    ⟨simplicialCochainPullback f n γ.1, by
      change simplicialCochainDifferential _ n (simplicialCochainPullback f n γ.1) = 0
      rw [← simplicialCochainPullback_differential]
      rw [show simplicialCochainDifferential _ n γ.1 = 0 from γ.2, map_zero]⟩
  let θ' : simplicialCocycles (A ⊔ B : (TopCat.toSSet.obj X).Subcomplex) (n + 1) :=
    ⟨simplicialCochainPullback (A ⊔ B).ι (n + 1) θ.1, by
      change simplicialCochainDifferential _ (n + 1)
        (simplicialCochainPullback (A ⊔ B).ι (n + 1) θ.1) = 0
      rw [← simplicialCochainPullback_differential]
      rw [show simplicialCochainDifferential _ (n + 1) θ.1 = 0 from θ.2, map_zero]⟩
  have hinput : (singularCohomologyMayerVietorisIso X U V hU hV hcover n).hom.τ₃
      (singularCohomologyClass _ n γ) = simplicialCohomologyClass _ n γ' := by
    change (homologyMap
      (integralSimplicialCochainPullback (singularSubsetIso X (U ∩ V : Set X)).inv) n ≫
      homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback
        (SSet.Subcomplex.eqToIso (singularSubset_inter X U V)).inv) n)
          (singularCohomologyClass _ n γ) = _
    rw [← homologyMap_comp, ← integralSimplicialCochainPullback_comp,
      ← simplicialCohomologyClass_toSSet]
    exact simplicialCohomologyClass_pullback f n γ
  have houtput : (singularUnionCohomologyIso X U V hU hV hcover (n + 1)).hom
      (singularCohomologyClass X (n + 1) θ) =
        simplicialCohomologyClass _ (n + 1) θ' := by
    rw [singularUnionCohomologyIso_hom, ← simplicialCohomologyClass_toSSet]
    exact simplicialCohomologyClass_pullback (A ⊔ B).ι (n + 1) θ
  have htransport : singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting X U V hU hV hcover n ≫
      (singularUnionCohomologyIso X U V hU hV hcover (n + 1)).hom =
        (singularCohomologyMayerVietorisIso X U V hU hV hcover n).hom.τ₃ ≫
          simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting A B n := by
    simp only [singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting,
      singularCohomologyMayerVietorisIso_inv_τ₁, Category.assoc,
      Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id, A, B]
    rfl
  apply (singularUnionCohomologyIso X U V hU hV hcover (n + 1)).toLinearEquiv.injective
  change (singularUnionCohomologyIso X U V hU hV hcover (n + 1)).hom _ =
    (singularUnionCohomologyIso X U V hU hV hcover (n + 1)).hom _
  rw [houtput]
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, htransport]
  erw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  erw [hinput]
  exact simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting_class_of_lift A B n γ' α β θ' hγ hθ

end Mumford.Analytic
